AVIATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: AVIATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. CPU
   C. Monitor
   D. Speaker

2. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

3. When learning Hangar Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Hangar Safety.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Hangar Safety.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Hangar Safety.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Hangar Safety.

4. When learning Aircraft Structures, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Structures.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Structures.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Structures.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Structures.

5. When learning Aircraft Propulsion, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Propulsion.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Propulsion.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Propulsion.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Propulsion.

6. When learning Flight Controls, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Flight Controls.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Flight Controls.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Flight Controls.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Flight Controls.

7. When learning Terminal Operations, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Terminal Operations.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Terminal Operations.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Terminal Operations.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Terminal Operations.

8. When learning Navigation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Navigation.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Navigation.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Navigation.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Navigation.

9. When learning Airfield Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Airfield Safety.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Airfield Safety.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Airfield Safety.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Airfield Safety.

10. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. International Cricket Team

11. When learning Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.

12. When learning Ramp services, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Ramp services.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Ramp services.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Ramp services.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Ramp services.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Flight Instruments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Navigation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Terminal Operations and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Ramp services and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
